$what: Provenance of ojz_act1_section_6.meta.json — aeon's OJZ act-1 section-6 sidecar, VENDORED into Aurora at a named aeon revision. ⚠ SINCE aeon e2af59ea (2026-09-16, regions-emit-bindings 3/3) THIS SIDECAR NO LONGER CARRIES THE BINDING. OJZ act 1 is in REGION MODE: `games/sonic4/data/editor/ojz/act1/regions.json` owns every scene and raster binding, and every `section_N.meta.json` scene/raster ref was nulled in the same commit. The binding that makes ojz_sec6_baseswap.json a document the editor must be able to open now lives on a REGION ROW, vendored beside this file as ojz_act1.regions.json. This file is kept, re-vendored, because its null `rasterRef` is itself the region-mode half of the claim: aeon's `tools/effects_gen.py` `check_mode_conflict` refuses the build when a region-mode act's sidecar still carries a scene or raster ref.
$why_vendored: It was read out of aeon's live working tree by test/formats/effects-preset-base-swap.test.ts alongside the preset. Same defect, same repair — see docs/OVERSEER.md bar 19 and docs/reviews/2026-09-04-baseswap-vendor-fixture.md. The vendored name differs from aeon's basename (`section_6.meta.json`) because this fixture directory is flat and holds documents from several acts; the aeon path below is authoritative.
